plugins.name: cctabs
plugins.description: Claude Code tab manager. Terminal tabs as the UI, no tmux. Claude can orchestrate its own sibling sessions.

plugins.name: browser-automation
plugins.description: Browser automation for Claude Code. Persistent Chrome profile, CDP connection.

plugins.name: mytranscriber
plugins.description: Local audio/video transcription via My Transcriber CLI. High-quality Whisper transcription on-device — no cloud. Requires the My Transcriber app installed.

plugins.name: review-md
plugins.description: Markdown → one self-contained styled HTML file (and a sane PDF). Build-time mermaid→inline-SVG, glyph callouts, footnote-integrity checking, dark mode, print stylesheet, doc packs, and an --artifact mode for Claude Artifacts.

plugins.name: revenueassistant
plugins.description: Work on deals, the pipeline and the CRM with The Revenue Assistant (https://therevenueassistant.com), the private sales assistant that runs on the person's own computer and their own Claude Code.

plugins.name: revenuemagnet
plugins.description: Grow a product with Revenue Magnet (https://revenuemag.net), the growth system an agent builds and keeps for the person, on their own computer and their own Claude Code.

plugins.name: mindmymoney
plugins.description: Your own money, worked on in Mind My Money (https://mindmy.money), the app that goes through your bank statements for you.

plugins.name: clerkai
plugins.description: A small business's bookkeeping prep, done in Clerk.AI (https://clerkai.eu), the app that gathers each period's statements and receipts and drafts the email to the accountant.

plugins.name: rememberthis
plugins.description: Your own life, from your photos, voice memos and notes, with Remember This (https://rememberthis.ai).
